messages:
kevin: Quick follow-up from the PG+KV timeout postmortem — want to lock owners for runbook edits, quick mitigations, and a playback exercise during next oncall rotation. Keeping items small.

pm_renee: thanks — can we surface the short list and owners here so I can mark the postmortem followups? :spiral_note_pad:

kevin: sure — propose:
- runbook DB triage + exact commands -> maria (3 business days)
- pager pre-checks + playback checklist -> jonathan (2 business days)
- job-scheduler/job-throttle policy investigation -> samira (1 week)
- routing controller fallback tuning -> infra/devops (1 week)

samira: i can own the scheduler investigation. i'll run a 48h sample of job start times and correlate with write qps. ETA 7 days.

maria: i'll do the runbook DB section. I'll add explicit checks and thresholds and a minimal `one-click` list for oncall. PR ETA 3 days.

jonathan: pager edits: adding a pre-alert step to check exporter health and a 5min DM to oncall before paging escalation. i'll include a short playback script for handoffs. will post PR in 48 hours.

sre_bot: Incident link: https://redwood.internal/incidents/2026/pg-kv-timeout-1763449000 — automated timeline + deploys attached.

kevin: maria, for DB commands please include both quick shell variants and kubectl variants. Example snippets:
```
# replication lag (SQL)
psql -c "select now() - pg_last_xact_replay_timestamp() as lag;"
# replication lag (kubectl)
kubectl exec -n infra svc/pg -- psql -c "select now() - pg_last_xact_replay_timestamp();"
# check circuit-breaker
curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $RB_TOKEN" https://ops.internal/api/cb/status?svc=pg | jq '.'
```
Make thresholds explicit: >=20s -> start mitigation steps, >=60s -> escalate and consider standby promotion.

maria: noted. i'll add the thresholds and link dashboards + alert queries. Also adding a short section: 'when to throttle background jobs' with recommended defaults.

jonathan: for pager playback i'll add this short checklist to the pager doc: 1) reproduce the pre-check commands 2) run the log dump `kubectl logs -l app=pg -n infra --tail=300` 3) run `pg_stat_statements` top queries 4) practice DM escalation. Keep it to a 5-10min run.

kevin: good. recurring pattern: we've seen three partial timeouts in the past 10 weeks during large background reindexes or bulk imports. We should add a trigger in the job scheduler to delay big jobs when DB QPS > 2000 for 5m. Samira, can you validate that threshold during your analysis?

samira: yes — i'll validate and propose a safe default (and a quick rollback plan) in the findings.

maria: created ISSUE-1315 for runbook edits -> PR #433 (draft).
jonathan: created ISSUE-1316 for pager + playback -> PR #434 (ready for review).
samira: created ISSUE-1317 for scheduler investigation -> will link PR/notes when ready.

pm_renee: nice. cadence: owners update this thread every 3 business days until PRs merged. i'll mark postmortem as 'followups in progress' once all three issues exist.

kevin: one small UX ask: in the runbook, please add 'quick links' at top to dashboards, relevant alerts, and the postmortem. makes triage faster.

maria: will include quick links + a one-line TL;DR at the top.

jonathan: also adding a note to include who to cc on escalation (pod leads + infra oncall) and an optional slack shortcut to run the quick checks.

sre_bot: Follow-up reminder scheduled for 3 business days: 1763833121.

kevin: thanks all :thumbsup: let's keep items scoped small — aim to close the runbook and pager PRs within a week, scheduler follow-up can be 7 days. ping here when PRs open so pm_renee can update the postmortem.
